Explosion at Qatar gas facility injures 54, leaves 18 missing

An explosion and fire occurred at Qatar's Barzan gas supply facility in Ras Laffan Industrial City, a major LNG hub. The incident, which happened during the restart of operations, has resulted in at least 54 injuries and 18 people missing. The Qatari Interior Ministry has attributed the blast to a 'technical accident', and investigations are underway. The event has raised concerns internationally, with reports indicating Indian and Pakistani nationals among the casualties.
